evidence_slice: Chelmsford City Council states that the Local Plan was adopted on 27 May 2020 and identifies Strategic Growth Site 2: West Chelmsford. The developer submitted outline planning application 21/01545/OUT in August 2021 for up to 880 new homes, a primary school with co-located early years and childcare nursery, five serviced travelling showpersons plots, sports/community facilities, a neighbourhood centre, landscaping, public open space, roads and infrastructure. The Planning Committee resolved on 3 December 2024 to grant permission subject to conditions and completion of a Section 106 agreement.
